title: Psalm 98
opening_line: O sing a new song to the LORD,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: O sing a new song to the LORD,
text.normalized: O sing a new song to the LORD,
text.reading: O sing a new song to the LORD,

text.diplomatic: for wonders he hath done:
text.normalized: For wonders he hath done:
text.reading: for wonders he hath done:

text.diplomatic: His right hand and his holy arm
text.normalized: His right hand and his holy arm
text.reading: His right hand and his holy arm

text.diplomatic: him victory hath won.
text.normalized: Him victory hath won.
text.reading: him victory hath won.

text.diplomatic: The LORD God his salvätion
text.normalized: The LORD God his salvätion
text.reading: The LORD God his salvätion

text.diplomatic: hath causèd to be known;
text.normalized: Hath causèd to be known;
text.reading: hath causèd to be known;

text.diplomatic: His justice in the heathen’s sight
text.normalized: His justice in the heathen’s sight
text.reading: His justice in the heathen’s sight

text.diplomatic: he openly hath shown.
text.normalized: He openly hath shown.
text.reading: he openly hath shown.

text.diplomatic: He mindful of his grace and truth
text.normalized: He mindful of his grace and truth
text.reading: He mindful of his grace and truth

text.diplomatic: to Isr’el’s house hath been;
text.normalized: To Isr’el’s house hath been;
text.reading: to Isr’el’s house hath been;

text.diplomatic: And the salvation of our God
text.normalized: And the salvation of our God
text.reading: And the salvation of our God

text.diplomatic: all ends of th’ earth have seen.
text.normalized: All ends of th’ earth have seen.
text.reading: all ends of th’ earth have seen.

text.diplomatic: Let all the earth unto the LORD
text.normalized: Let all the earth unto the LORD
text.reading: Let all the earth unto the LORD

text.diplomatic: send forth a joyful noise;
text.normalized: Send forth a joyful noise;
text.reading: send forth a joyful noise;

text.diplomatic: Lift up your voice aloud to him,
text.normalized: Lift up your voice aloud to him,
text.reading: Lift up your voice aloud to him,

text.diplomatic: sing praises, and rejoice.
text.normalized: Sing praises, and rejoice.
text.reading: sing praises, and rejoice.

text.diplomatic: With harp, with harp, and voice of psalms,
text.normalized: With harp, with harp, and voice of psalms,
text.reading: With harp, with harp, and voice of psalms,

text.diplomatic: unto JEHOVAH sing:
text.normalized: Unto JEHOVAH sing:
text.reading: unto JEHOVAH sing:

text.diplomatic: With trumpets, cornets, gladly sound
text.normalized: With trumpets, cornets, gladly sound
text.reading: With trumpets, cornets, gladly sound

text.diplomatic: before the LORD the King.
text.normalized: Before the LORD the King.
text.reading: before the LORD the King.

text.diplomatic: Let seas and all their fulness roar;
text.normalized: Let seas and all their fulness roar;
text.reading: Let seas and all their fulness roar;

text.diplomatic: the world, and dwellers there;
text.normalized: The world, and dwellers there;
text.reading: the world, and dwellers there;

text.diplomatic: Let floods clap hands, and let the hills
text.normalized: Let floods clap hands, and let the hills
text.reading: Let floods clap hands, and let the hills

text.diplomatic: together joy declare
text.normalized: Together joy declare
text.reading: together joy declare

text.diplomatic: Before the LORD; because he comes,
text.normalized: Before the LORD; because he comes,
text.reading: Before the LORD; because he comes,

text.diplomatic: to judge the earth comes he:
text.normalized: To judge the earth comes he:
text.reading: to judge the earth comes he:

text.diplomatic: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,
text.normalized: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,
text.reading: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,

text.diplomatic: his folk with equity.
text.normalized: His folk with equity.
text.reading: his folk with equity.
